Subject: Privacy and hosting decisions | MAP check-in & next steps

Hi James —

Quick weekly check-in on the MAP items we discussed last week focused on data handling and deployment modes. Attached is an updated one-pager (Acme_MAP_v2.pdf) that captures the decisions we need to lock down before the evaluation starts. Top items for this week: 

- Hosting: customer-managed VPC vs Redwood Private on-prem package (you indicated both are options)
- Data retention windows (evaluation telemetry vs production artifacts)
- PII handling and in-flight encryption expectations

Could you confirm who on your side owns the procurement/security paperwork so we can coordinate the SOC2 evidence request? Suggested agenda for our next 30-min checkpoint (Wed): 1) confirm hosting choice and blockers, 2) retention windows for evaluation tokens/logs, 3) any required redaction or data minimization.

Action items from me: attach the updated MAP PDF and the SOC2 evidence checklist we typically share.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the hosting decision so the eval can be scheduled.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: 2027-02-21T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Privacy and hosting decisions | MAP check-in & next steps

Kimberly —

Thanks for the note and the updated MAP. Quick answers from our side: 

- Hosting: we prefer a customer-managed VPC in our AWS account for the evaluation. On-prem is unlikely for this phase due to procurement timelines.
- Retention: for the eval period (4 weeks) we can accept 30-day retention for logs/telemetry; production will require configurable 7–90 day windows.
- PII: we will need tokens hashed at rest and TLS in flight; any customer-supplied prompts that include PII must be marked and excluded from model telemetry.

Procurement has looped in our security lead, Mei Tan (meitan@acme-robotics.com), and procurement (procure@acme-robotics.com). Mei will send over the SOC2 items we need you to provide. Can we keep Wed at 10am PT for the checkpoint?

Regards,
James Liu
Head of Product, Acme Robotics
james.liu@acme-robotics.com

Quick update following the Wed check-in and the security sync with Mei: 

- Retention: draft retention profiles attached. For evaluation we recommend 'Eval-30d' (tokens + telemetry 30 days). For short-term pilots you can offer 'Pilot-7d' as a configurable option; production customers can choose 7/30/90 day presets.
- PII controls: built-in prompt redaction will be available in the eval build; we will add a toggle to exclude any redacted prompts from telemetry.
- Evidence: Mei requested the SOC2 evidence spreadsheet (Acme_SOC2_Request.xlsx) and a pointer to our shared drive with logs sampling; I uploaded a redacted sample set (link below) and emailed Mei the Doc with next steps.

Attachments: retention_profiles_v1.xlsx, redacted_sample_logs_20270224.csv
